title: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Lakish
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Tosefta Sanhedrin, chapter 1. The name should read Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish, as in Zuckermandel's Tosefta. So too in the Rif and the Rosh on Sanhedrin 6b, and in the Sheiltot, Mishpatim.

notes.text: The Yehoshua/Yehudah correction is Hyman’s comparison of the Tosefta edition, Rif, Rosh and Sheiltot.
The consulted Tosefta reads Yehoshua ben Lakish, while Sanhedrin 6b attributes the parallel to Resh Lakish. Hyman reports Yehudah in the other editions and works he cites.
